 Dramatic victory for Tampines Rovers over Ratchaburi at ASEAN Club Championship Shopee Cup™ 
 You are here: Home 
 2026 
 Dramatic victory for Tampines Rovers…
 SINGAPORE (18 November 2026) – Substitute Jacob Mahler scored a dramatic injury-time winner as Tampines Rovers FC secured a thrilling 3-2 win against Ratchaburi FC in Group A of the ASEAN Club Championship Shopee Cup™ on Wednesday.
 Worrawoot Srimaka’s visiting team had led twice at Jalan Besar Stadium through goals by Pablo Insua and Robert Žulj in the 34th minute and 67th minute respectively but Tampines Rovers equalised through spectacular strikes by Seiga Sumi in first-half added time and Hide Higashikawa in the 69th minute.
 After coming on as a substitute in the 74th minute, a day after playing against Brazil while representing Singapore during the FIFA international window, Mahler rose majestically to head home the winner in the 93rd minute for the Stags to secure their first win of the tournament.
 Both teams enjoyed promising opportunities in the opening exchanges, with the home side coming close in the 14th minute when Sumi’s low effort was comfortably saved by Ratchaburi goalkeeper Kampon Phatomakkakul.
 Higashikawa, the leading goalscorer with six goals in the Singapore Premier League, threatened soon after with a powerful right-footed attempt from outside the box that flashed just wide of the visitor’s far post.
 After replacing an injured Rafael Bilu, substitute Ekanit Panya quickly became a thorn to the Tampines Rovers’ defence, setting up Tana in the 16th minute, only for the Spaniard’s attempt to be blocked for a corner.
 Goalkeeper Zharfan Rohaizad then produced an excellent save in the 31st minute to deny Jordan Gele but five minutes later, a defensive lapse gifted Ratchaburi the lead.
 From a corner, Sorawit Panthong whipped a cross into the box where Tampines Rovers midfielder Yuki Kobayashi’s headed clearance fell invitingly into the path of an unmarked Insua who easily beat Zharfan from close range.
 A minute into first-half added time, the Stags hit back in style. Picking up a loose ball from just inside his own half, Sumi was given the space to drive at the Ratchaburi defence before unleashing a left-footed shot beyond the despairing reach of Kampon.
 The Thai club went ahead for the second time in the match in the 67th minute through a penalty conversion by Robert Žulj, following a handball by Irfan Fandi.
 However, it took Tampines Rovers only two minutes to draw level again, and the equaliser was a stunner.  After collecting a pass from Koya Kazama, Higashikawa cut back onto his right before unleashing a thunderous shot which gave Kampon no chance.
 Then came the match-winner by Mahler who buried his header into the bottom corner from a corner by Yuki Kobayashi as Nazri Nasir’s team picked up all three points.
 Shopee Star of the Match – Hide Higashikawa (#25), Tampines Rovers FC
